biography.value:
Description

Paleberries are small, usually no taller than three feet. They have white skin, round heads with small snouts, blue eyes and a fish tail. They wear dark blue cloaks with hoods and carry an old-fashioned lantern and a small butcher knife. Paleberries usually reside within icy caves and attack alone.

Defense

AC 21, touch 16, flat-footed 16 (+4 dex, +5 natural, +1 dodge, +1 size)

hp 90 [144] (12d10+24); mp 28

Fort +10, Ref +12, Will +7

Immune Holy, Negative status effects

Offense

Speed 20 ft.

Melee Chef's Knife +18 (1d3+4, 18-20/x2) (special, see below)

Special Attacks Chef's Knife, Everyone's Grudge, Karma

Spells Known (SC CL 12th; Concentration +15)

1st (DC 15) - light

2nd (DC 16) - light II

3rd (DC 17) - lightra, light III

Statistics

Str 8, Dex 18, Con 14, Int 11, Wis 16, Cha 12

Base Atk +12; CMB +10; CMD 24

Feats Combat Casting, Dodge, Improved Initiative, Light Focus, Weapon Finesse, Weapon Focus (Knife)

Skills Perception +15, Sense Motive +15, Stealth +16

Languages Tonberry; telepathy 30 ft.

Gear Small butcher knife, lantern

description.value: Once per round, a paleberry may make a melee attack with its knife. If a creature is struck by it, it must make a Fortitude save (DC 20) or it is reduced to -1 hp, stabilized and unconscious. Those who are immune to critical hits are immune to this and take the knife damage only. The knife is only deadly in the hands of a paleberry, who has finesse training with it.

save.description: Negates the -1 HP, stabilized and unconscious effect. Critical-immune creatures take knife damage only.

effect: Save-only alternative for a successful knife hit, once per round. Do not make two saves or roll damage twice. A failed save leaves the target stabilized and unconscious at -1 HP.

description.value: There is a 10% chance when a paleberry takes damage from an attack action or spell made by a foe, it gains an additional use of Everyone's Grudge that it may use as a free action against the character that damaged it. This extra use can only be made against its assailant and only on the round the paleberry received damage. This ability does activate on damage suffered from sneak attacks and attacks of opportunity. This ability can be used a number of times per round equal to its Dexterity bonus and it also increases the damage by 1 each time it is used. It cannot use this ability on the same opponent twice per round.

effect: Karma chance: [[1d100]]. 01-10 after enemy attack/spell damage, including AoOs/sneak attack. Free Grudge against assailant this round; once per foe; max Dexterity modifier/round.

save.description: Half retaliation damage on a successful save.
